description: Decode a cable type designation (DIN VDE, HAR, BS/IEC, NEC, TS, UTE, CEI-UNEL and 32 more of its 39 coding systems, plus LAN and fibre) into its layers: conductor, insulation, screen, armour, sheath, with the source behind each symbol. Deterministic, no LLM.

code.description: A cable type designation as printed or listed, e.g. "NYY-J 3x1,5", "N2XSEYRY", "12/2 NM-B", "H07RN-F 3G2,5".

name: decode_cable_code
title: Decode a cable designation
